top_signals.title: Big Oil Scores $56 Billion Windfall on Spiking Fuel Prices
top_signals.summary: Big Oil reaped more than $50 billion in windfall profits as conflicts in the Persian Gulf and Russia drove refining results to record highs. ExxonMobil Holdings Corp., Chevron Corp., BP Plc, Shell Plc and TotalEnergies SE all surpassed third-quarter expectations with combined adjusted net income of $56.3 billion. Bloomberg's Vincent Piazza joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hasty US exit from Europe could drive allies away from American arms, RAND says
top_signals.summary: A rapid, uncoordinated U.S. military drawdown from Europe could push key NATO allies further away from American weapons, a RAND study found.

top_signals.title: Miami Firms Buy InterContinental Hotel for About $300 Million
top_signals.summary: Gencom and White Bridge Capital bought the InterContinental hotel in downtown Miami, marking the companies’ third joint hospitality deal in the past year.
